table: Table 11. Data ranges for quality control of individual variables
note: Table 11 lists WHICH variables get range checks and points to the appendix holding the numbers. The actual ranges live in Appendix 11 (p.86+) and are a function of BOTH depth (102 standard levels + one below 5500 m) AND ocean basin (16 basin columns). They are not single global min/max pairs.
lookup_rule: A standard depth between two listed depths uses the nearest listed depth; if equidistant, the shallower one (e.g. 5 m uses the 0 m values).

surface_envelope_example_temperature.warning: Illustrative only. These are the WIDEST (0 m) bounds across basins. Using them at all depths will pass deep outliers: at 3000 m the real maximum is far below 35 °C.
